children: Startups in the UAE topped the fundraising activity in the Middle East and North Africa (MENA) region in August, raising a combined $362 million in investments.

The funds, spread across 13 deals, represent the bulk of the total funding raised across the region, which more than doubled (up 117%) to $375 million from July and up 11% from a year ago, according to Wamda/Digital Digest.
Saudi Arabia came second with total funding raised at $10.25 million across six deals, followed by Jordan ($2 million), Oman ($500,000), Iraq ($150,000), and Bahrain ($100,000).
Fintech saw the most number of deals valued at $83.75 million but the mobility sector scored the highest value in one transaction, thanks to the record $250 million deal secured by Moove.
(Writing by Cleofe Maceda; editing by Seban Scaria) seban.scaria@lseg.com

title: UAE startups secure $362mln in August 2026
